# Daivik Borewells

Daivik Borewells is a borewell drilling contractor serving Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

## Services

- Borewell drilling with large rigs for open sites
- Compact borewell drilling for narrow roads and existing homes
- Robo borewell drilling for restricted-access spaces
- Groundwater site assessment
- Borewell deepening and casing installation
- Submersible pump selection, installation and testing

## Properties served

Homes and villas, apartments and residential layouts, farms and agricultural land, and commercial properties.

## Service areas

All Bengaluru, including Kanakapura Road, Kengeri and Hosur Road, plus Nelamangala, the Airport Road / Devanahalli corridor and Doddaballapura. Site visits are free; scheduling and machine suitability depend on the actual site.
